prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE edited test image from Image 1.

STRUCTURE MUST KEEP
Keep the complete scene, composition, object positions, building silhouettes, heights, road markings and full square diorama framing of Image 1. Use one orthographic parallel camera across ground, buildings, walls and props; preserve straight planar ground, coherent wall/roof edges and the two planar front cut faces. Do not introduce curved ground, displaced corners, rotated buildings or perspective convergence. Preserve the two rear exit passages and all their clear walking approaches. Keep credible doors and the existing functional roof equipment, its supports and connections. Do not crop any part of the base.

CURRENT SCENE
The existing roadside shops at NIGHT: the connected L-shaped two-storey red building and lower cream/blue shop wing, retro repaired rooftop machinery, phone booth, utility pole, small left guardhouse and bicycle, right pickup truck, sparse weeds and exposed foundation/service pipes must remain recognizable and in place. Keep the restrained repaired Salvage Cyberpunk and cassette-futurist equipment designs. Keep the current reduced wear density; do not add rust streaks or new peeling everywhere.
Maintain the cool navy night atmosphere, WHITE practical lamps at their existing locations, lit shop windows and readable cool shadow planes. Keep exactly TWO SMALL separate puddles at their current road positions, with localized smooth white light reflections. The rest of the road stays dry and matte.

ART / REFERENCE ROLES — CLEAN COLOR PLANES WITH SELECTIVE PAINTED TONE VARIATION
The requested change is the treatment of broad material surfaces: walls, asphalt, roof panels and vehicle bodywork. Let most of each surface read as one quiet, clean, continuous base-color plane. Within selected areas add a few LARGE, broad, sparse brush marks and irregular flat color patches in closely neighboring hues and values. Preserve substantial uninterrupted areas of the base color. The marks should be visible but understated, with a clear long-stroke direction following each surface. On the asphalt use broad strokes following the road plane, with enough quiet unmarked space between groups.
These marks represent flat pigment/color variation, including on UNDAMAGED paint and plaster; they are independent of rust, dirt, peeling and cracks. Borrow the large understated tonal brush patches on the cream facades of Image 3 and the quiet broad wall planes of Image 2. Do not turn every patch into weathering. Keep intact broad paint on the pickup and buildings.
REMOVE the tiny repeating, embossed, wriggly or broken-glass texture from dry pavement and other solid surfaces. No impasto thickness, wavy contour tracery, embossed brush edges, cellular mosaic, tessellated tiny rectangles, granular noise, global canvas texture or full-surface scratch patterns. The brush marks do not bend geometry or create specular relief. Do not flatten everything into a single featureless fill either.
Use clear large light/shadow masses to describe volume and sparse material-specific highlights. Retain readable structural thickness, grounding and edges. Do not replace pigment patches with photoreal microtexture or uniformly glossy/plastic shading. Maintain the NIGHT exposure and white lamps while adapting the references' broad tonal grouping; do not copy their daytime sun or add a sky/sea.

Image 1: EDIT TARGET, authority for scene contents, layout, camera framing and night lighting. Replace its surface finish as specified; do not preserve its fine road texture.
Image 2: M03-10 / ldi_10_storefront_style_anchor, reference ONLY for large calm wall color planes, restrained material information, clear forms and grouped light/shadow. Do not copy shops, characters, source camera, lettering or UI.
Image 3: user-supplied painting, reference ONLY for broad neighboring-tone pigment patches, sparse directional brushwork and simple light/shadow grouping on the cream, slate and colored facades. Do not copy its tall fantastical buildings, bridge/legs, water, boat, people, setting or perspective.
No added objects, captions, comparison panels, watermarks or labels. Deliver one coherent, complete diorama.
